period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Statement of Financial Position'/'Statement of Comprehensive Income' (this filing's first use of IFRS-style statement names, replacing the 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' labels used in the 2011-2013 filings; distinct from the 'Consolidated Statement of Financial Position'/'Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income' shown alongside them in the same filing). Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to June 2014' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended April to June 2014' column (interest income 4,105,235,643; PAT 467,307,973; EPS 0.78) not recorded here. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly (187,537,804,920 = 170,850,854,863 + 16,686,950,057). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly. Preference share capital remains nil at solo level (as in 2013_Q2), though the Consolidated statement newly shows Tk 851.51m of preference share capital at Jun-2014 — a bKash/subsidiary-level instrument outside the solo entity, not recorded here per this project's stated preference for solo. Consolidated comparison: consolidated PAT cumulative 966,769,729 vs solo 792,383,712; consolidated EPS cumulative 1.77 vs solo 1.46. RESTATEMENT NOTE (data-quality check): this filing's own comparative 'Cumulative Jan to Jun 2013' column (the same period covered by 2013_Q2.json) shows solo PAT 877,924,056 (a 1-taka rounding difference from the 877,924,055 reported contemporaneously — not substantive) but EPS restated down to 1.80 (vs. 1.98 originally reported in 2013_Q2.json), consistent with the retrospective weighted-average-share (BAS 33) effect from the paid-up-capital increase between Jun-2013 (4,433,045,760) and Jun-2014 (7,092,873,210) already flagged in 2013_Q2.json's period_note. Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 Q4/annual series (solo).
